get.description:
The current head of every chain. Store these outside the database: passing them
back to /verify later detects deletion of the newest entries, which a hash walk alone
cannot (DD-12).

The audit trail as CSV for external audit tools (A7.2). At most 50,000 rows;
narrow the filters for more.

Walks every chain, re-computing every hash. With `expected` anchors it also detects
deletion of the newest entries; without them it cannot (DD-12).

post.description:
Reopens a resolved exception (including one the auto-resolver closed) for a person
to look at. It returns to at least Tier 2: it was wrong to treat it as automatic.
Re-hashes every stored file; a modified or missing one raises FILE_TAMPERED.
An analyst pairs one internal and one external transaction that matching left apart.

Undoes an automatic or confirmed match (the whole group for a split or netted one).
The pair is never matched again.

B4.3: newest day first, banks in parallel, exact matching only for the first pass,
then the full pipeline queued as a background job. Returns the preliminary recovery
figures for the CFO's report.
